To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) students are able to use photographs and video to develop explanatory models of natural phenomena, 2) students are able learn to use photographs and videos to develop explanatory models, and 3) students are able use explanatory models to make predictions about natural phenomena.
students are able to use photographs and video in ways that lead to inquiry, and to the development of explanatory theories.
students can develop and justify explanatory models of complex systems by collaborating with peers around images of the systems in action.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to help learners make sense of complex phenomena through image data.
how students can use photographs and video to develop explanatory models.
how students can use photographs and videos to develop explanatory models that are both personally meaningful and scientifically valid.

the paper is a well-written, well-structured paper that provides an excellent introduction to the field and to the research of the authors.
students who learn to use images to develop explanatory models of complex phenomena will have a better understanding of those phenomena.
students are able to use photographs and video to construct and test explanatory models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to create a new kind of learning environment that uses photographs and video in the same way that scientists use them--as a primary data source.

we have developed a framework and a set of tools to support students in learning through explanation, and that we have developed two learning environments, one for middle school students and one for high school students, that use the framework and the tools to support students as they learn to use photographs and video as the basis for developing explanations.
we are trying to develop a framework to support students in developing explanatory models that are grounded in image data.

students can use photographs and video to develop explanatory models, and that these models can be used to predict future events.
